recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The conformance definitions are already correct; this fixes the remaining stale build metadata needed for accurate R5-to-R6 change reporting.
issue_request: FHIR-46492 requested R6 core changes matching the subscriptions backport design: collapse SubscriptionTopic.resourceTrigger and eventTrigger into trigger, define filters and notification shapes per trigger, add optional Subscription.filterBy.event, and add optional SubscriptionStatus.notificationEvent.triggerEvent for notification-level event granularity.
initial_application: The primary model and narrative changes were applied by commit 25f6cefe21d8fa411503d934b072a4f13c90c8a3. Current SubscriptionTopic, Subscription, and SubscriptionStatus source definitions contain the requested trigger, event, per-trigger filter/shape, filterBy.event, and notificationEvent.triggerEvent elements.
additional_context: FHIR-43888 supplied the same backport IG rationale. FHIR-I minutes on 2024-08-05 approved FHIR-46492 and confirmed the Subscription.filterBy.event name. A later QA commit added fhir.ini R5-to-R6 change metadata after the original application, but that metadata still treated eventTrigger children, notificationShape.include, and selected resourceTrigger children as deleted or only new rather than moved.
reconciliation: Updated source/fhir.ini in the active [r5-r6-changes] section to map SubscriptionTopic.eventTrigger, eventTrigger.description, eventTrigger.event, eventTrigger.resource, notificationShape.include, resourceTrigger.description, resourceTrigger.resource, and resourceTrigger.supportedInteraction to the corresponding SubscriptionTopic.trigger paths.
source_changes: source/fhir.ini: corrected R5-to-R6 mappings for SubscriptionTopic.eventTrigger, SubscriptionTopic.resourceTrigger, and SubscriptionTopic.notificationShape.include to their SubscriptionTopic.trigger paths.
